questions.q: At the gate, you'll need to show your passport and your ___.
questions.explainRo: **Boarding pass** = cartea de îmbarcare, documentul cerut la poarta de îmbarcare.

questions.q: The booking website was down for half a day – the longest ___ we've ever had.
All the tests are green again, so Alex ___ the bug last night.
questions.explainRo: Testele trec, deci suntem aproape siguri că s-a întâmplat: **must have + V3**.

questions.q: The new version was full of bugs, so we ___ (roll) back to version 2.3.
questions.explainRo: **Roll back** = a reveni la versiunea anterioară; aici la past simple: rolled back.

questions.q: My invoice never reached the client. There could be many reasons – it ___ ended up in her spam folder, for example.
questions.explainRo: Nu suntem siguri, e doar o posibilitate, deci folosim **might have + V3**.

questions.q: You ___ the keys in the car – I saw you put them in your bag.
questions.explainRo: Pentru o deducție negativă („nu se poate să fi…”) folosim **can't have**, nu „mustn't have”.

questions.audio: You could have told me earlier!
answers: You could have told me earlier!
questions.explainRo: **Could have + V3** = ai fi putut, dar n-ai făcut-o – un reproș.

questions.q: Nobody answered the door when we knocked. They ___ (might / go) out for dinner.
questions.explainRo: Pentru o posibilitate în trecut folosim **might have + V3**: might have gone.

questions.q: Our flight was cancelled and we lost all that money. We ___ (should / buy) travel insurance!
questions.explainRo: Regretul sau critica despre trecut se exprimă cu **should have + V3**.

questions.ro: Trebuie să fi așteptat ore întregi.
questions.explainRo: Pentru o deducție despre o acțiune în desfășurare folosim **must have been + -ing**.

questions.ro: N-ar fi trebuit să rezervăm cel mai ieftin hotel.
questions.explainRo: **Shouldn't have + V3** = n-ar fi trebuit să facem asta, dar am făcut-o.

questions.ro: Trebuie să fi fost o greșeală de tastare în adresa de email.
answers: There must have been a typo in the email address.
There must've been a typo in the email address.
There must have been a typo in the e-mail address.
It must have been a typo in the email address.
It must've been a typo in the email address.
There must have been a typing mistake in the email address.
There must've been a typing mistake in the email address.
questions.explainRo: Deducția „trebuie să fi fost” = **must have been**; „greșeală de tastare” = **typo**.
